symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two binary input strings.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the number of bits in each input string, so the product has $2n$ bits.

relations.quote: The established multiplier, also called the Harvey–van der Hoeven multiplier, is a known algorithm for [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md): it takes two binary strings and outputs their product.
